pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, non-uniform polygonal regions. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients with moderate transition zones between dark and light pigments. Spatial area of dark patches is significantly larger than the separating negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of trivalent intersections. Pixel thickness is narrow (estimated 5-12 pixels) and maintains relatively high continuity across the mid-section and flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The mane presents as a series of short, vertical extensions against the background, consistent with a cropped mane structure.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized reduction in mane height is visible at the transition point where the lower neck meets the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Visible vertical textural disruptions and hyper-pigmented thickened skin areas on the mid-flank, characterized by a wrinkled appearance that deviates from the surrounding pelage pattern.
